payload.title: Sync gateway live-push completeness + extension-authoring exports
payload.description: Close the remaining 'server → live client' and extension-authoring gaps surfaced by the aquarius-os integration. Sibling to FR-109 (projection delta-push, done): same realtime fan-out machinery, broader surfaces. Children: FR-114 (server-originated object/stream writes must fan out to gateway subscribers, not just appear on cursor resync) and FR-113 (export the policy-hook + blob-processor authoring types from @frick/server so apps can write extensions without ServerOptions-indexing hacks).
